page.overview:
Who is Abraham Simpson, Sr.?

Abraham "Abe" Simpson, Sr. is a "father" of Grampa Simpson.

During at blackout at Christmas Grampa Simpson tells the family about his boyhood before TV except Bart noticed how what happened all seem to the same as returns of various TV shows.

He and his father (where he nearly cuts off his arm in the buzzsaw). year in particular this one year. It was Christmas Eve, and his Daddy had gone way up on Simpsons Mountain (he is actually on a bender). His Momma was pretty near with sick with worry when Abe Sr. has not been seen since yesterday, so she sent Grampa, then called Abe-Boy, out to fetch his Daddy back. At night began to fall Abe-Boy began to despair of ever finding his Daddy and then sees him standing alone on a bridge where they essentially reenact the scene on the bridge towards the end of It's a Wonderful Life.
